_readme: The checkpoint's UI pass (Sam, 2026-10-08; .claude/commands/checkpoint.md step 9). Every view a person reads: each COBI tab in index.html's nav and each standalone page a11y.config.js measures. last is the day of the view's last pass, outcome what it found and fixed in a sentence, hold the reason a view is skipped. scripts/ui_pass.py --next picks the view; --record stamps it; --check (CI) fails when a view is missing or unknown.

surfaces.name: Sierra
surfaces.outcome: AA, the 24px targets, focus rings, the keyboard and reduced motion pass at nine widths in all four views (arriving and asking, light and dark); First Light holds (every hex in a :root block, Playfair Display and Source Sans 3 self-hosted, dark on the cpl_theme contract); the chat function and the feedback RPC agree with the COBI surfaces (sierra_surfaces_aligned). Nothing to fix.

surfaces.name: Veteran map
surfaces.outcome: Ported to First Light on Sam's Sheet 55 ruling (S350): tokens in :root only, dark on the cpl_theme contract and followed live inside COBI, the two faces embedded; AA, the 24px floor (pins exempt through the two directories) and the keyboard pass at nine widths, light, dark and embedded. Fixed on the way: COBI's Military Partnerships frame overflowed by 170 to 280px and shrank the stars to 4px; ?embed=1 fills the frame and a marker size floor holds the approved size.

surfaces.name: SkyView
surfaces.outcome: First pass (S351): AA, targets and the keyboard hold at all 11 routes (Sky by night, Globe, Map, the comprehensive view, the workspace tabs, the outline, the work sheet) and its sweep passes 233 of 233. First Light: 20 raw-hex declarations in the template's component rules. Three were dark failures no route reaches (white on the night canvas's #7DA1D4 at 2.65:1: the member-row hover, Put back's hover, the pressed Night word); they write var(--on-accent) now (6.95:1). The four status chips read role tokens by day and at night, and dark's four chip rules are gone. Wiring: three pass RPCs, shared with COBI's phrase gates.

surfaces.name: Fact Sheet
surfaces.outcome: First pass (S350, #1926): 141 targets under 24px fixed, the action bar no longer pins 200px of a phone, raw hex and injected fallbacks became tokens, the recs toggle's undefined --accent became --cobalt, three toolbar glyphs became words. S352: the page never defined --on-accent, so Ask Sierra on hover and the drawer's Send painted body ink on cobalt at 1.35:1 (#1934, with a guard on any bare var() the page does not define). Then First Light (#1938, Sam: 'Fact Sheet looks great!'): Playfair Display and Source Sans 3 self-hosted, COBI's dark palette screen-only on the cpl_theme contract, seal navy split into fill and ink; print and Save as Word keep Cambria and Calibri. fact-sheet and fact-sheet-dark pass at nine widths.

surfaces.name: Privacy
surfaces.outcome: First pass (S351): AA, the 24px targets and no sideways scroll held at nine widths; First Light's colors were in place but not its type (system-ui) and it had no dark mode. Now Playfair Display and Source Sans 3, self-hosted from sierra/fonts/, and COBI's dark palette on the cpl_theme contract; light and dark measure clean (privacy-dark is a new a11y target). Wiring: no dataset; Google's consent screen is its one link. Its words still describe the Drive filer, parked 2026-10-08, and stay while that screen links the page.

surfaces.name: Funding model
surfaces.outcome: First pass (S351): AA, focus, the keyboard and the 24px targets hold at nine widths and in My CPL Funding; First Light holds (the engine's tokens, the theme's type). One fault: the Columns menu, hung from its summary's left edge, opened past the viewport where the toolbar sets it right (480 to 561px and 1024px; 53px at 560) and the page scrolled sideways. It now hangs from the right edge when it would pass the viewport and fits that way, placed on render, open and resize (tests/cpl_funding_colmenu_edge.test.js). Wiring: the explainer and COBI's Public view agree row for row (119 rows, defaults; the live config is out of the sandbox's reach); College Briefing calls the same model (college_briefing_funding_sync).

surfaces.name: Dashboard
surfaces.outcome: First pass (S352, #1937): clean in light and dark. Before, 16 and 10 contrast findings, 20 targets under 24px, 9 keyboard-unreachable scrollers, an h1 to h3 skip and 4 controls with no focus ring. The 'How this is calculated' panels read white on white on nine cards (the base CSS assumed a dark card that no longer exists); College Activity's literal hex inks kept their light values in dark; its four filters suppressed their focus rings inline; the trophy and the toolbar's squared operators are gone. Fixed in excel_to_dashboard.py, its College Activity template, kpi_cards.js, college_activity.js and both HTMLs. Wiring: the tab reads no dataset the dependency map names (its sections are generated). First Light: College Activity's and KPI Trends' titles still set Georgia rather than Playfair Display.

surfaces.name: Activities
surfaces.outcome: S354: npm run a11y light and dark was 71 targets under 24px in 7 kinds, 4 light contrast pairs (#888 3.54, #999 2.85, gold ink 1.95, On Track badge 4.47), an h1 to h3 skip, Element Map without a ring; now clean in both themes at 1440 and 390. Controls are underlined words (activity links, CPL Workplan, Element Map, Table / Archive, its glyph removed); gray labels read --text-muted; Stretch words --mustard-text; badge tint 0.15; Activities is the h2. Wiring: the view reads no mapped dataset. Left: raw #888 ink elsewhere in the generator (other tabs), and report_generator.js's Custom Report button is still boxed.

surfaces.name: Team & RACI
surfaces.outcome: First pass on Team & RACI: fixed 36 sub-24px Update targets and every contrast finding in both themes (decorative and undefined inks, the mustard fill used as text, row opacity, a white close mark on a header that turns light in dark mode), made every control an underlined word, gave the sortable headers real column-header semantics, contained the directory's 223px sideways scroll at 390px, and removed the loading placeholder that centered the matrix; edit-mode keyboard access and the Mission Control wiring entry are deferred.

surfaces.name: MAP Users
surfaces.outcome: Seeded signed-in sweep (roster and contact worklist, light and dark) found 28 controls under 24px, the search box's focus ring hidden, two tables pushing the page sideways at 390px, and in the first fix --on-accent on --seal-blue at 1.43:1 in dark; controls became underlined words, emoji labels words, raw hex tokens (--white on --seal-blue), each table a named region scrolling below 560px; all four seeded views pass, guarded by tests/map_users_first_light.test.js.

surfaces.name: Annual Workplan Goals
surfaces.outcome: S375: keyboard reach for every editable value and the chip line (the cell editors also threw on every save and Escape in Chrome, fixed), header scopes and row headers, classes for 715 raw hexes, phone cards below 560px, Current in ink, Add description for editors, the Add dialog's checkboxes to 24px (#2054, #2057); the gray band is the fixed First Light background.

surfaces.name: Budget
surfaces.outcome: The bar's labels were white on every fill (1.21:1 in dark, where --navy-primary turns light): each fill now carries its own text color; the as-of line and the gray dot failed AA (the dot removed); the two holders that scroll at 390px are focusable and named; the section's raw hex became tokens; the editor's Sign in and Sign out are underlined words (S363). S364 finished it with a seeded signed-in sweep (budget-editor, both themes): a cell mid-save read 1.35:1 in dark (light text on the #FFF6D9 pastel), so the save states take the dark-only tints with light fallbacks, a failed save is a red outline on a muted ground, the widget and the hover wash are --surface-subtle, and the editor's status line and rejected input use --red-alert and --green-progress rather than #A33 and #2A7D4F. Measured clean in light and dark at desktop and 390px, signed out and signed in.

surfaces.name: Implementation Funding
surfaces.outcome: Measured clean signed out in light and dark at desktop and 390px, and in the Public view and My CPL Funding; a new seeded curator sweep (funding-curator, both themes) found the editing controls the signed-out sweep never paints. Every boxed or filled control became an underlined cobalt word (Rename, Remove, Hide from public, Add project, New scenario, Publish, Save), the view in use (Internal or Public) shows by weight and aria-pressed rather than a fill, Cancel lost its inline box, Edit (22.6px wide) and the card-size sliders (19.9px tall) reach 24px, words keep their line so New scenario no longer wraps over its hint at 390px, and the hidden-from-public note became a paragraph so its link takes the inline exception. My College and the explainer call the same model (_alloc, _grant), so their figures agree by construction. Tokens only on screen; the print and memo windows keep literal colors, being separate documents. Guarded by tests/cpl_funding_controls_first_light.test.js.

surfaces.name: Contracts
surfaces.outcome: First pass. The register is gated, so the signed-out sweep measured its gate; a seeded reviewer sweep (contracts and contracts-dark, the V0718 fixture through the tab's own load) found the band's faint labels at 3.56:1 in dark, where --navy-primary turns light, text in the decorative --text-faint at 3.62:1 in light (item numbers, the caret, the executed note), and a status chip on the browser's dark button face at 1.99:1. The band is now --seal-blue in both themes with --white and --on-seal-blue-muted, that text is --text-muted, the chip sets its own ground, and Draft, Record, Confirm, Open and Choose a file are underlined words; the hover's raw #fff is gone. Reads four tables no other view reads. Guarded by tests/contracts_first_light.test.js.

surfaces.name: Vision 2030
surfaces.outcome: S365 #2001: sweep clean light+dark before and after; measured at 320/390/1024: 44px sideways scroll at 320 (grid floor 300px -> min(300px,100%)), bars 0px on phones and 12px at 1024 (label took the row; bar now above it), Action 1a/5 text matched no source (now the CPL Workplan's words, shared with the annual report), Goal 1 fill width:1419.5% (held to 0-100, bars aria-hidden), inline styles to classes. Goal figures differ from the annual report: Open Asks Sheet 64 card 1.

surfaces.name: Military Partnerships
surfaces.outcome: S365: sweeps clean light+dark (tab and the three veteran-map targets) before and after; measured 320/390/1280: below a 981px frame the map printed its own h1 and lede under the tab's heading, pushing the map below the frame's fold on a phone (content 2,094px at 320 -> 1,843; 1,715 at 390 -> 1,547), now screen-reader-only at every width in the embed; the paragraph's link painted browser-default ink (#0000EE / #9E9EFF), now --accent-link, arrow glyph dropped. Remainder named: below a 981px frame the map scrolls inside its frame by design (its stage is in vh).

surfaces.name: CPL Pathways
surfaces.outcome: S367, after Sheet 65 card 2 (#2015, the table read): sweeps clean light+dark before and after on the tab, the catalog record (both layouts) and the college select; two new seeds (cpl-pathways-table: an unchecked record read from the table at 320/390/1440; -dark: a record read that failed) paint the table states, and screenshots with the table stubbed read 23 programs, no sideways scroll at 320. Found and fixed: the provenance line read 'Long Beach City College's college's own catalog pages reading procedure' (custom_html label); the record's Lay out and Viewer toggles, Ask Sierra, PDF, Quick Adopt and the ladder's open button were boxed or filled, now underlined words (24px; PDF measured 24px, the open word 30px, both themes), the view in use in weight; the Student/College toggle gained aria-pressed and a labeled group, its fill gone; four decorative emoji left a toggle and two headings. Remainder named: the stage selector and the program pills still fill to mark state (a toggle set colored by stage), and the tab's 30 status and legend marks (the check, the diamond) stay with their legend; wiring: program_requirement_records and program_source_registry are now shared with Program Requirements and College Briefing under one read policy, not compared live (the sandbox cannot reach Supabase).

surfaces.name: Noncredit & Learning Partners
surfaces.outcome: S365: sweeps found an h1 -> h3 skip (sections now h2, cards h3), the section chip at 4.38:1 (opacity .85 on --text-muted, removed) and the dormant table unreachable by keyboard at 390px (a named region); a new team-phrase seed (nc-partners-editor, -dark) painted notes, an artifact and Revise for the first time and found the artifact title link 20px tall (24px now); controls became underlined words and the toolbar, Attach artifact and status lines dropped their glyphs. Both themes and both seeds pass.

surfaces.name: Governance
surfaces.outcome: S366: seeded governance-editor (+dark): h2->h4 skip, three tables scrolling at 390/320 unreachable by keyboard (named regions, th scope), Docs panel blank after a repaint, the shell's dashed centered placeholder left on the root, dialog on glass with no Escape or focus return; controls as underlined words, the green stance chip and 3 glyphs removed, raw hex fallbacks gone. Wiring: figures agree; sierra_feedback row caps fixed in a sibling PR.

surfaces.name: Team Phrases
surfaces.outcome: S366: seeded team-phrases-reviewer (+dark) passed contrast and targets; read on screen: five unnamed inputs, the save message's doubled 'phrase', a key emoji and two leading check marks (one choosing its own color), boxed and filled buttons, a full mustard warning and a gold chip, ~15 raw hex fallbacks. All fixed; wiring: team_access is only a reviewer probe in Sierra Training.

surfaces.name: Admin
surfaces.outcome: S368: seeded the reviewer view (admin-reviewer, -dark). 112 targets under 24px, a 4.31:1 Save button, 79px sideways scroll at 320 and an unreachable scroller fixed; item names no longer squeezed to one letter (the Admin row's own name vanished at every width); controls as underlined words; mustard warning and phrase chips quieted; the Heading column's caret, the doubled link chip and the stale About glyph removed. Light and dark clean at 320/390/1440.

surfaces.name: MAP Team Queue
surfaces.outcome: S368: seeded the phrase-holder view (map-queue-team, -dark). The shell's dashed loading box stayed on the root and centered the whole queue; off now. Full-red badges and ages muted to red words, cleared items no longer green, links cobalt and underlined, the cleared-items toggle 24px, 63px sideways scroll at 320 fixed (a 320px flex basis, then long tokens), the heading's emoji and the Go to arrows removed, counseling spelled American. Light and dark clean at 320/390/1440. Wiring: the governance count reads the same register and owners table as Governance.

surfaces.name: My College
surfaces.outcome: First pass on a college's page (new seeded targets my-college-page and -dark; the cobi sweep stops at the scope question): public readers saw No contact listed in MAP beside a contacts table listing the coordinator (the public row has no primary contact; it now measures the coordinator or counselor); 29px sideways at 320px (grid floors clamped); undefined --link and --warn painted raw hex, 2.47:1 in dark; section titles are h3; controls are underlined words. Clean light and dark at 320, 390, 1440.

surfaces.name: College Identity
surfaces.outcome: S371: seeded roster targets (college-identity-roster, -dark: both reads stood in with real map_colleges rows). Found and fixed: 49px sideways scroll at 320px (a path in the snapshot note); six columns colliding at 390px (now a labeled stack below 560px); the placeholder codes X00/X02 and 570/X01 read beside 'No MIS code' (now 'Placeholder code, not an MIS code'); an arrow for 'resolves to'. Wiring agrees: My College and Funding drop the 8 sandbox rows as the suppressed note says. Tokens all defined in both themes. Open: two partner rows say 'organisation' in live data; receipt filed, the write needs Sam (the repo guard holds it).

surfaces.name: Annual Report
surfaces.outcome: First pass. npm run a11y found the preview scrolling with no keyboard reach at 390px (both themes); the screen showed four boxed glyph buttons, an unlabelled editor, unannounced status lines colored green and a raw #A33, hex fallbacks in its CSS, centered report prose and literal underscores on the data date. Fixed in one PR: underlined word controls (26px), labelled editor, the preview a named keyboard region, status announced and red only for a failure, tokens only, left-aligned, the date in italics. Wiring: the 8 headline KPIs the report quotes match CPL_DATA and the Dashboard cards; item_updates activity rows are the same newest-per-key the cards paint. a11y: 1 finding to 0, light and dark.

surfaces.name: Common Course Reference
surfaces.outcome: The list a curator works in was never measured (the tab opens on SkyView): new a11y targets ccr-list and ccr-list-dark. Light 3 contrast + 5 target kinds and dark 5 contrast (toggle 1.29:1, id column 1.76:1) to 0 in both themes, 390 and 1440; the map view's missing h1 now a screen-reader heading. Tokens only in the tab's CSS; the launcher, view toggle, Cleanup impact, Suggested merges, Verify and Export are underlined words; emoji out of the banner, toolbar and search fields; the id column wraps again; caret and info at 24px. Remaining: the Merge, Unify and worklist dialogs' inline hex (about 90 in unified_courses.js) and the squeezed column headers.
